title: was/were
subtitle: I was / you were
summary: Use was and were to talk about the past, and make negatives, questions and short answers with them.

lesson.heading: Robert last night and now
lesson.text: It is the morning and Robert is at his desk with his computer. Now Robert **is** at work. At midnight last night he **wasn't** at work. He **was** in bed. He **was** asleep.

examples.text: At midnight last night he **wasn't** at work. He **was** in bed.

lesson.heading: Sentences and questions
lesson.text: **was/were** needs no other verb. In questions it goes before the subject, after a question word like **why** or **where**.

examples.text: Last year Rachel **was** 22, so she **is** 23 now.
When I **was** a child, I **was** afraid of dogs.
We **were** hungry after the journey, but we **weren't** tired.
**Was** the weather nice when you **were** on holiday?

lesson.heading: Short answers
rows: Yes, I / he / she / it was.
No, I / he / she / it wasn't.
lesson.note: 'Were you late?' 'No, I wasn't.' - 'Was Ted at work yesterday?' 'Yes, he was.'

lesson.text: Only **I**, **he**, **she** and **it** take **was**. Everything else takes **were** - and that includes **you**, even for one person.

exercises.prompt: Now Robert is at work. At midnight last night he was in bed. Which sentence is right?
options: He isn't at work last night.
exercises.explanation: he + was, so the negative is he wasn't.

exercises.prompt: I feel fine this morning, but I ___ very tired last night.
Don't buy those shoes. They ___ very expensive.
exercises.explanation: The shoes are expensive now, so the present: they are.

exercises.prompt: Last year she ___ 22, so she is 23 now.
exercises.explanation: Last year is the past: she was 22.

exercises.prompt: Does the subject take was or were?
Where ___ at 11 o'clock last Friday morning?
exercises.explanation: In questions, were comes before the subject: Where were you ... ?

exercises.statement: We weren't happy with the hotel. Our room was very small and it wasn't clean.
exercises.explanation: Correct. we takes weren't, and our room (= it) takes was / wasn't.

exercises.prompt: Mark ___ at work last week because he was ill. He's better now.
exercises.explanation: Mark = he, so the past negative is wasn't.

exercises.prompt: Match each question with the right answer.

pairs.left: Why were you late this morning?
Where were Sue and Chris last week?
How much was your new camera?
Was the weather nice last week?

exercises.statement: You wasn't at home last night. Where was you?
exercises.explanation: You weren't at home last night. Where were you? - you always takes were.

exercises.prompt: Yesterday was a public holiday, so the banks ___. They're open today.
exercises.explanation: the banks = they, so were closed.

exercises.prompt: Make a question with was/were. Put the words in the right order: (your new camera / how much?)
exercises.answer: How much was your new camera?
